hero.title: Turn your PDF into a fluid digital book
hero.description: Convert static PDFs into a clean, flowing EPUB that respects your book’s structure, cover, chapters, and imagery.

step1.title: Upload your PDF
step1.text: Drag the document you want to convert into the upload area, or pick it from your device.

step2.title: Let the AI process it
step2.text: Our engine scans the document and intelligently realigns text, tables, and images without breaking the layout.

step3.title: Download your EPUB
step3.text: Grab your file once it’s ready and send it to whichever e-reader you like.

section1.title: Flawless formatting
section1.text: Chapter structure, covers, and tables stay intact — no more broken layouts.

section2.title: Super fast
section2.text: Even lengthy PDFs turn into EPUBs in a short time.

section3.title: Full privacy
section3.text: Your files are only used for the conversion and are never shared with anyone else.

item1.title: Students and academics
item1.description: Read two-column papers comfortably on a phone.

item2.title: Independent authors
item2.description: Get manuscripts ready for digital storefronts.

item3.title: Book lovers
item3.description: Read PDF books found online without eye strain, with a larger font.

q1.question: Are my files safe?
q1.answer: Yes. Your files are only used for the conversion itself and are never shared with anyone else.

q2.question: Is it free?
q2.answer: You can try the converter for free — no credit card required.

q3.question: Will images and charts get lost?
q3.answer: No. Images, tables, and diagrams are carried over into the EPUB true to their original layout.

q4.question: Can I upload a password-protected PDF?
q4.answer: Password-protected PDFs aren’t supported yet — please remove the password first and try again.
